The '''''Prana Lexander''''' was a science [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] that was lost nearly five hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Among those aboard it before it disappeared was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Unidentified alien philosopher|philosopher]] who was greatly respected by members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] for his historical knowledge. The fate of ''Prana Lexander'' became the subject of rumor and legend until it was eventually found by agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They freed the philosopher from [[Suspended animation/Legends|cryofreeze]] and persuaded him to join their cause.<ref name="RPG" />
